Back around December 2013, Matt did a musical performance online for fans to attend on StageIt. It was great to watch live; he interacts with his audience far more than most bands I've seen, and you can tell that he enjoys what he does. I recorded that show, and thought it would make a good first post to start of this subverse!

link

The songs played in this set are:

  • Heart in Hand
  • One of You
  • On the Sea
  • Lovestruck
  • Send it Up
  • Man who would be Santa

Unfortunately, the recording software that I used was pretty bad, and I didn't realize that the recording was crackling until the end when I started watching it. I also have no idea if Matt is ok with this being shared online; I'm not looking to make money off of it or anything, it's just here so that fans of his music can watch it. If he wants it to be taken down, I will of course oblige.

With that out of the way, enjoy!
